verdict.rationale: Pipedream's MCP tool listing for at least one app explicitly counts '4 triggers' alongside 46 actions, implying trigger-based (event) tools are exposed through the MCP interface, but no documentation explains how an agent actually subscribes to or receives pushed webhook events via MCP (vs. just invoking trigger-setup tools). Missing for 10: explicit description of event/webhook subscription mechanism over MCP transport, confirmation that triggers push asynchronous events to the agent rather than requiring polling or external workflow configuration, and hands-on/independent corroboration.
